source: Angelini, Parisi, Ricci-Tersenghi, arXiv:1401.6805v2, section III.D, PDF pages 15-16
convention: Paper sigma equals this project's s; x=(2-s)/2; Delta_epsilon=2-1/nu.
selection: All four primary inverse-nu determinations explicitly reported by these authors in the 2d subsection. No fit or digitization.
